name: scoped-strict-typecheck
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p tsconfig.bapa.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bun test core/sized-sort.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1

name: full-typecheck
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun run typecheck > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1

name: package-typecheck
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit --declaration false > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1
